eam.geometry: FCC Cu, 14 cells/axis, a=3.61 Angstrom, deterministic 0.001*a distortion
eam.potential: Sutton-Chen Cu; in-tree EAMPotential functions; shifted pair term
eam.oracle_representation: setfl sampled from the same analytic functions: dr=0.0001 Angstrom, nrho=200001, drho=0.005, nr=55001. Unused r<1 Angstrom regularized. ATV analytic; LAMMPS cubic interpolation.

sw-lj.geometry: diamond Si, 11 cells/axis, a=5.43 Angstrom, deterministic 0.001*a distortion
sw-lj.potential: Original Stillinger-Weber Si plus shifted LJ epsilon=0.01 eV, sigma=2 Angstrom; benchmark composition, not a fitted silicon model
sw-lj.oracle_style: hybrid/overlay sw lj/cut (OMP suffix for threads>1)
sw-lj.oracle_representation: same in-tree SW parameter row exported to .sw; all analytic

lj.geometry: simple cubic at density 0.8, deterministic initial positions and velocities

stage_timing_note: LAMMPS Pair uses the final MPI aggregate section, including force reduction; separate OMP thread maxima on MPI rank 0 are retained (not MPI-global maxima). Historical artifacts selected the final thread Pair row for OMP and should not be used as MPI Pair totals. Total loop ratios are unaffected.
limitations: Shared Apple M4 desktop: WindowServer, browsers and other ordinary applications remained active. No task build/test overlapped. All raw samples retained; no outlier rejection or general backend parity claim.
EAM analytic ATV versus LAMMPS setfl interpolation of identical parameters; strict oracle checks bound representation errors but do not make kernel representations identical.
SW+LJ is an artificial Full/Half composition benchmark, not a fitted silicon potential.
Current/previous many-body ratios include framework, image-contract and SW changes; they do not isolate one optimization. LJ has no paired prior-binary timing in this pass.
Orthorhombic boxes only. CPU CellList explicitly rejects triclinic cells; full-cell PR/LJ regression is a known unsupported envelope.
Initial and one-step energy/force checks do not establish long-trajectory or pressure-value equivalence.
